settings.name: Usman Ghani
settings.title: Stepped dual-level design is genius
settings.content: The stepped dual-level design is genius! I keep a small money plant on the lower tier and serving trays on the top tier. The vertical gold rods give it a very sleek contemporary aesthetic.

settings.name: Ayesha Siddiqa
settings.title: Exceeded all my expectations
settings.content: Exceeded all my expectations! The black gold marble looks super luxurious and the warm gold finish matches my living room theme perfectly. Delivery took 5 days to DHA Lahore.

settings.name: Fahad Alvi
settings.title: Unique designer furniture look
settings.content: Very unique design that you don't find easily in local furniture markets. The split-level layout makes it look like designer furniture. Sturdy build and no assembly hassle.

settings.name: Hafsa Munir
settings.title: Sturdy & multi-functional
settings.content: The table is beautiful and sturdy. The stepped shelves allow multiple decorative pieces without looking cluttered. Highly pleased with the purchase.

settings.name: Omer Sheikh
settings.title: Durable gold coating & easy to clean
settings.content: The gold coating is durable and hasn't scratched. Black marble top wipes clean with a microfibre cloth without any water marks. Excellent value for money.

settings.name: Khadija Rehman
settings.title: Superb support on WhatsApp
settings.content: Very pleased with the quality and customer support on WhatsApp. Delivered safely packed with zero scratches. Will be ordering side tables soon!

settings.name: Taimoor Shah
settings.title: Modern & minimalist
settings.content: Modern, minimalist yet opulent. The split height tiers add great depth to our living room space.
